decisions.reason: Because the lubrication system is close to the firm's core fluid-management business and the firm is expanding with R&D and organisational slack in a growing industry, management would likely keep it unless results clearly disappointed aspirations.

As a hydrocyclone coolant filter that directly builds on the firm's established filtration offer, it likely meets or comes close enough to aspirations to avoid problemistic search, especially given the firm's broad product range and investment capacity.

The gravity band coolant filter sits very near the firm's core capabilities and one-stop systems logic, so in an expanding and innovative firm it is likely to be retained unless there is strong evidence of persistent underperformance.
